climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Médoc appellation in Bordeaux for red wine, made from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and other Bordeaux grapes. It covers Moulis-en-Médoc and four neighboring communes.
